scope.clock_basis: Platform timestamps are publication clocks. Payload at is preserved as reported; live_fill.at is the reported venue fill clock; order/cancel at is the local event clock; neither proves exact batch observation order.

request.filter: "nightcrawler.speeddesk: speeddesk_live_fill " OR "nightcrawler.speeddesk: speeddesk_live_cancel " OR "nightcrawler.speeddesk: speeddesk_live_settlement " OR "nightcrawler.speeddesk: speeddesk_live_pair_protected " OR "nightcrawler.speeddesk: speeddesk_live_reject " OR "nightcrawler.speeddesk: speeddesk_live_stop "

coverage.statement: Filtered closed log returns do not certify continuous input, full account, or absent events.

protection_exercise.absence_means: No returned standalone evidence; absence does not prove no protection or no opportunity.

settlement.no_double_credit: Payout counted once; paired credit and net payout are receipt details.
